newsitem.title: NORWAY: Arafat to visit Norway on October 28-29.
newsitem.headline: Arafat to visit Norway on October 28-29.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat will visit Oslo this month to review the peace process that started with secret talks under Norwegian mediation three years ago, a foreign ministry offical said on Wednesday.
Arafat will be in Oslo on October 28-29 at the invitation of the Norwegian government for talks with Prime Minister Gro Harlem Brundtland and Foreign Minister Bjoern Tore Godal, the spokesman said.
"There will be a full review of the peace process," he said.
He said Arafat accepted the invitation during a meeting with Godal in Gaza on Tuesday.
Godal, whose government helped broker the 1993 Israeli-Palestinian peace pact, was in the Middle East in an effort to help get the peace process back on track.
Israeli Foreign Minister David Levy at a separate meeting with Godal also accepted an invitation to visit Norway, but a date has yet to be set, the spokesman said.
